Game Overview

In Santa Throw, the core idea is straightforward: leap into the festive adventure of Santa Throw, where Claus jumps his way through whimsical obstacles. Master the art of charged jumps to reach the checkered platform. Experience evolving stages filled with vibrant surprises and quirky challenges. Get ready for a jolly journey through this unique and bouncy holiday escapade!
